script:
# Split samples into 4 groups based on naming convention
cohort_a_ctrl_samples <- c("CohortActrl1", "CohortActrl2", "CohortActrl4")
cohort_a_si_samples   <- c("CohortAsi1", "CohortAsi2", "CohortAsi5")
cohort_b_ctrl_samples <- c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4")
cohort_b_si_samples   <- c("CohortBsi1", "CohortBsi2", "CohortBsi3")
# Verify samples exist
cat("CohortA ctrl:", cohort_a_ctrl_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortA si:", cohort_a_si_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortB ctrl:", cohort_b_ctrl_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
cat("CohortB si:", cohort_b_si_samples %in% colnames(df_unique), "\n")
# Scientific correction to the reported replay fixture: retain all planned genes for BH adjustment.
# This example assumes verified log2 expression and independent biological replicates;
# it is not a raw-count RNA-seq model or a test of between-cohort interaction.
# Differential analysis: Compute log2FC and p-values for two comparisons
# Since data is already log2-transformed, mean difference = log2FC directly
compute_diff <- function(expr_mat, ctrl_samples, trt_samples) {
  ctrl_mat <- as.matrix(expr_mat[, ctrl_samples, drop = FALSE])
  trt_mat  <- as.matrix(expr_mat[, trt_samples, drop = FALSE])
  # This example excludes an entire contrast if any planned observation is missing
  # or infinite; neither the effect nor the test silently drops observations.
  complete_rows <- complete.cases(ctrl_mat, trt_mat) &
    rowSums(abs(ctrl_mat) == Inf, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 &
    rowSums(abs(trt_mat) == Inf, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
  ctrl_mean <- ifelse(complete_rows, rowMeans(ctrl_mat), NA_real_)
  trt_mean  <- ifelse(complete_rows, rowMeans(trt_mat), NA_real_)
  log2fc    <- trt_mean - ctrl_mean
  
  # Preserve failed tests and their reasons; do not turn them into negative evidence.
  tests <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(expr_mat)), function(i) {
    if (complete_rows[i]) {
      tryCatch({
        list(pvalue = t.test(trt_mat[i, ], ctrl_mat[i, ], var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
             test_error = NA_character_)
      }, error = function(e) list(pvalue = NA_real_, test_error = conditionMessage(e)))
    } else {
      list(pvalue = NA_real_, test_error = "Missing or non-finite expression in this contrast; complete observations are required.")
    }
  })
  pvals <- as.numeric(vapply(tests, function(result) result$pvalue, numeric(1)))
  test_errors <- as.character(vapply(tests, function(result) result$test_error, character(1)))
  # One predeclared family per cohort contrast, including untestable genes in n.
  # Adjust before selecting by p-value, effect size, or plot labels.
  adjusted <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH", n = length(pvals))
  data.frame(
    id = rownames(expr_mat),
    log2FoldChange = log2fc,
    pvalue = pvals,
    padj = adjusted,
    test_error = test_errors,
    meanLog2Expression = (ctrl_mean + trt_mean) / 2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
# Comparison 1: CohortA_si vs CohortA_ctrl
res_cohort_a <- compute_diff(df_unique, cohort_a_ctrl_samples, cohort_a_si_samples)
colnames(res_cohort_a)[2:6] <- paste0("CohortA_", colnames(res_cohort_a)[2:6])
# Comparison 2: CohortB_si vs CohortB_ctrl
res_cohort_b <- compute_diff(df_unique, cohort_b_ctrl_samples, cohort_b_si_samples)
colnames(res_cohort_b)[2:6] <- paste0("CohortB_", colnames(res_cohort_b)[2:6])
# Merge
diff_df <- merge(res_cohort_a, res_cohort_b, by = "id")
cat(sprintf("\nMerged results: %d genes\n", nrow(diff_df)))
cat("\nSummary of CohortA log2FC:\n")
print(summary(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange))
cat("\nSummary of CohortB log2FC:\n")
print(summary(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange))
cat("\nFirst 5 results:\n")
print(head(diff_df[, c("id", "CohortA_log2FoldChange", "CohortA_pvalue", "CohortB_log2FoldChange", "CohortB_pvalue")], 5))

# BH-adjusted p-value and effect-size thresholds (strict inequalities).
fdr_cut <- 0.05
fc_cut <- log2(1.5)
cohort_a_testable <- is.finite(diff_df$CohortA_padj) & is.finite(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange)
cohort_b_testable <- is.finite(diff_df$CohortB_padj) & is.finite(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange)
both_testable <- cohort_a_testable & cohort_b_testable
cohort_a_sig <- cohort_a_testable & diff_df$CohortA_padj < fdr_cut & abs(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange) > fc_cut
cohort_b_sig <- cohort_b_testable & diff_df$CohortB_padj < fdr_cut & abs(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange) > fc_cut
both_same <- cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange * diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange > 0)
both_opp <- cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig & (diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange * diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange < 0)
# Keep each contrast's result even when the other contrast is untestable.
diff_df$CohortA_meets_threshold <- ifelse(cohort_a_testable, cohort_a_sig, NA)
diff_df$CohortB_meets_threshold <- ifelse(cohort_b_testable, cohort_b_sig, NA)
# A one-cohort threshold crossing does NOT establish a cohort-specific effect.
# Test an interaction/contrast of effects to support that scientific claim.
diff_df$status <- "Not testable in one or both"
diff_df$status[both_testable] <- "Neither meets thresholds"
diff_df$status[both_testable & cohort_a_sig & !cohort_b_sig] <- "Meets thresholds in A only"
diff_df$status[both_testable & !cohort_a_sig & cohort_b_sig] <- "Meets thresholds in B only"
diff_df$status[both_testable & both_opp] <- "Both (opposite direction)"
diff_df$status[both_testable & both_same] <- "Both (same direction)"
diff_df$status <- factor(diff_df$status, levels = c(
  "Neither meets thresholds", "Not testable in one or both",
  "Meets thresholds in A only", "Meets thresholds in B only",
  "Both (opposite direction)", "Both (same direction)"
))
cat("Category counts:\n")
print(table(diff_df$status))
# Top genes for labeling
get_top <- function(subset_df, p_col, k = 5) {
  if (nrow(subset_df) == 0) return(subset_df[0, ])
  ord <- order(subset_df[[p_col]])
  head(subset_df[ord, ], min(k, nrow(subset_df)))
}
top_labels <- rbind(
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (same direction)", ], "CohortA_padj"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Both (opposite direction)", ], "CohortA_padj"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Meets thresholds in A only", ], "CohortA_padj"),
  get_top(diff_df[diff_df$status == "Meets thresholds in B only", ], "CohortB_padj")
)
top_labels <- unique(top_labels)
cat(sprintf("\nGenes to label: %d\n", nrow(top_labels)))

# Invalidate the previous image before publishing results from this run.
unlink("diagonal_volcano.png")
# Preserve the complete evidence before any plotting dependency or device can fail
write.csv(diff_df, "diagonal_volcano_diff.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano_diff.csv\n")
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info("diagonal_volcano_diff.csv")$size / 1024))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel)})
# Only finite paired effect estimates can appear on an effect-comparison plot.
# Keep all original rows and values in the CSV, including unplottable evidence.
plot_rows <- is.finite(diff_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange) & is.finite(diff_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange)
plot_df <- diff_df[plot_rows, ]
lim <- max(c(abs(plot_df$CohortA_log2FoldChange), abs(plot_df$CohortB_log2FoldChange), fc_cut, 1))
plot_note <- ifelse(nrow(plot_df) == 0,
  "No genes with finite effect estimates in both contrasts; see CSV.",
  sprintf("%d of %d genes have finite effect estimates in both contrasts.", nrow(plot_df), nrow(diff_df))
)
status_colors <- c(
  "Neither meets thresholds" = "grey75",
  "Not testable in one or both" = "#555555",
  "Meets thresholds in A only"                    = "#1f77b4",
  "Meets thresholds in B only"                    = "#ff7f0e",
  "Both (opposite direction)"   = "#2ca02c",
  "Both (same direction)"       = "#d62728"
)
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = CohortA_log2FoldChange, y = CohortB_log2FoldChange)) +
  # Background non-significant points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, status == "Neither meets thresholds"),
    aes(color = status), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Highlighted significant groups
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, !status %in% c("Neither meets thresholds", "Not testable in one or both")),
    aes(color = status), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  # A cross distinguishes untestable genes with finite effect estimates.
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, status == "Not testable in one or both"),
    aes(color = status), shape = 4, size = 1.5
  ) +
  # Reference diagonal line (y = x) and threshold cross
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 30, segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.2,
    box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = status_colors, limits = names(status_colors), breaks = as.character(unique(plot_df$status)), drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Effect comparison: CohortA si vs ctrl  |  CohortB si vs ctrl",
    subtitle = paste(sprintf(
      "BH-adjusted p < %.2f per contrast; |log2FC| > %.2f; %d genes",
      fdr_cut, fc_cut, nrow(diff_df)
    ), plot_note, sep = "\n"),
    caption = "Threshold membership does not establish cohort-specific effects; untestable genes remain in the CSV.",
    x = "log2FC (CohortA si vs CohortA ctrl)",
    y = "log2FC (CohortB si vs CohortB ctrl)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", plot = p, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png\n")
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size / 1024))
